speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of painless, fixed supraclavicular lymphadenopathy with "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss) and the absence of pain upon palpation is highly specific for Hodgkin lymphoma.
